name: Generic HL7 v2.x ORU^R01
//: The standards-conformant reading. A laboratory that follows HL7 needs no profile of its own; one that does not gets a file like this with its own field locations. Nothing here changes what a result status or an abnormal flag means — those come from HL7 tables 0085 and 0078, and letting a site redefine 'critical' is not flexibility.
